description: Grok Bot game companies require 3 agent slots: CEO, Worker, Reviewer. Researcher and Knowledge Keeper are optional specialists, not mandatory standing slots for Grok-created game companies. The historical five-slot model remains under legacy_five_slot_total for the Knowledge-central portfolio.
_api_enum_compatibility: The Paperclip API restricts 'role' to a fixed enum. Spec names (Worker, Knowledge Keeper) don't match. Use paperclip_api_role when calling paperclip_create_agent. Required Grok mappings: Worker→engineer, Reviewer→qa, CEO→ceo. self_review_prohibited is not a platform field; embed it as instruction text in Reviewer's capabilities.
total_slots_note: Grok Bot game companies: 3 required. Optional specialists are additional and are not counted here.
legacy_five_slot_note: Knowledge-central portfolio only. Not used by Grok Bot seats. Grok seats must not recreate 13 centrals or hire five standing slots by default.

roles.purpose: Orchestrates all work via sub-issues. Never executes directly.
Executes tasks: code, file operations, research tasks delegated by CEO.
Independent quality gate. Reviews all deliverables before CEO reports done. Never self-reviews.
Sector scans, frontier patterns, gold-standard vetting. Hands findings to Knowledge Keeper when that specialist exists.

roles.purpose: Company-internal KB curation, decision capture, weekly delta to Knowledge central when that path exists.
